name: עַרְקִי
summary: The Arkites, a clan among Canaan’s descendants; the definite singular names the clan as a whole. The genealogy supplies no derivation.

evidence.note: The Arkites appear between the Hivites and Sinites in a list identified as the clans of the Canaanites.
The parallel genealogy repeats the same three gentilic nouns in the same order.

note: Moved from the former word entry `3areqiy`. ערק was the consonantal base of the gentilic. The genealogy supplies no verbal etymology.
